Commentary.Commentary: We are ready for the chase! The players have made their way out to the middle. Sidra Ameen and Muneeba Ali are at the crease. Hayley Matthews will start with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! West Indies Women need early wickets here to give Pakistan Women a tough fight. A loss here for them will make it tough for them to move forward. Will Pakistan Women get their first victory? We will find out. Stay tuned!

Anam Amin is down for a quick chat. She says that she tries to bowl as many dot balls as possible and likes to stick to her game plan. Tells that they would like to take it ball-by-ball and chase down the target.

A disappointing batting show by the power-hitters, West Indies Women! They did get off to a decent start, thanks to Deandra Dottin. But she failed to go on till the end. No batter out there found any sort of rhythm. They did get a few runs at the end of the innings which helped put up a target of 90 runs. West Indies Women do have some good spinners as well! This chase is not going to be that easy for Pakistan Women since the pitch is assisting the bowlers.

Pakistani bowlers have justified their skipper's decision to bowl first! It was spin to win for them. The spinners were right on cue. They caused a lot of trouble out there in the middle and did not let any batter settle in. They grabbed their first wicket in the fifth over, and made sure to capitalize on the same, as they took wickets at regular intervals. Nida Dar was the leader of the pack as she picked up four wickets and gave away just 10 runs in her spell. Fatima Sana and Nashra Sandhu were superb as well as they grabbed a wicket each. They have a golden opportunity here to get their first win!

End of a scintillating bowling performance by Pakistan Women! It was absolute carnage out there! After the heavy downpour this morning, it was raining wickets this time! It could have been a lot worse for West Indies Women, but they scored 23 runs off the last two overs and have done some sort of damage control.

Full ball, on off. Aaliyah Alleyne hits it straight back on to the stumps at the non-striker's end. The ball ricochets off the stumps towards extra cover for a single. West Indies Women end with 89/7.

NOT OUT! TWO LEG BYES! This is a low full toss, angling in from middle. Aaliyah Alleyne skips down a bit and looks to flick but she misses and gets hit low on her pad. The batters look to sneak in a leg bye. Fatima Sana gets towards the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but she misses. The fielder backing up at short third man does not stop the ball cleanly and the batters take two leg byes in total. Bismah Maroof though opts for a review for LBW. The Ball Tracker shows that the ball would have missed the leg stump and Pakistan Women lose a review.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! A full ball, outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne lofts it over extra cover and bags a boundary.

NOT OUT! Aaliyah Alleyne survives! This is a length ball, angling in late. Aaliyah Alleyne looks to heave it across the line but she misses. The ball goes through to the keeper who collects the ball and scores a direct hit at her end. Alleyne was way down the pitch but she does well to get back in time.
Is that a run out? There is a throw at the striker's end by the keeper. The replay shows that the batter was just in.
TWO BYES! A full ball, well outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne looks to slog but she misses. The keeper fails to grab the ball and the batters take two byes.
Fuller in length, around off. Aaliyah Alleyne whacks it through mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs.
Full and outside off. Afy Fletcher lofts it over the cover fielder for a brace. 12 runs off the over.
Shorter in length, outside off. Afy Fletcher cuts it to the point fielder.
FOUR! AND AGAIN! Much-needed boundary for West Indies Women! Another ball that is tossed up, on middle. Afy Fletcher shimmies down and bludgeons it through mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Top shot! A loopy ball, on middle. Afy Fletcher skips down and heaves it through mid-wicket and bags a boundary.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne mistimes her cut towards point for a single.
Tosses it up, outside off. Afy Fletcher drags it to long on for a run.
A yorker-length ball, around off. Aaliyah Alleyne digs it out.
Full and on middle. Afy Fletcher drives it to long on and settles for a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne taps it towards point and takes a single.
Play and a miss! Good-length ball, outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne throws her bat at it but fails to get any blade on it.
BEATEN! Full and outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne looks to drive but she misses as the ball goes past her blade.
Leg bye! Back of a length, around leg. Afy Fletcher looks to flick but she misses and gets hit on her pad. The ball rolls to the leg side for a leg bye.
Fuller now, outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne drives it towards cover.
Wide of off, shorter ball. Aaliyah Alleyne looks to chop this but she misses.
Slower through the air, fuller ball, around off. Aaliyah Alleyne looks to cut this but she gets an inside edge just away from the stumps.
Another short ball, around off. Aaliyah Alleyne hangs back and cuts it towards point.
Shorter ball, outside off. Aaliyah Alleyne leaves it alone.
Aaliyah Alleyne comes to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! What is happening here? West Indies Women are losing their way completely! A team hat-trick for Pakistan Women! A set batter gone, a huge blow for West Indies Women! A loopy ball, full around off. Stafanie Taylor looks to go over long off, but the ball goes off the toe-end towards the left of the bowler. Stafanie Taylor takes a good return catch. That was hit hard, but Nashra Sandhu has made that look so easy!
Afy Fletcher comes to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Two in two for Nida Dar and Pakistan Women are all over West Indies Women at the moment! Henry looks to take on Dar but she ends up throwing away her wicket. Dar bowls it slower through the air, full and on off. Henry looks to go over long on but she ends up toe-ending it straight towards Aliya Riaz at long on who takes a juggling catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Aliya Riaz b Nida Dar

Commentary.Commentary: Chinelle Henry comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Knight looks to go big but she holes out! She skips down the track and looks to go downtown but ends up hitting it straight down the throat of Nashra Sandhu at mid on who takes a sitter. Nida Dar bags her third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Nashra Sandhu b Nida Dar

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, around leg. Kycia Knight looks to sweep but she misses and gets hit low on her pad.
Tosses it up, outside off. Taylor skips down the track and pushes it wide of the extra cover fielder for a quick single.
On a length and outside off. Taylor punches it to cover-point.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Stafanie Taylor looks to cut but she misses.
An appeal for LBW, but tuned down! Loopy ball, full around off. Kycia Knight looks to sweep this but she misses.
Flatter ball, around middle. Kycia Knight steps down and defends it back to the bowler.
Sharp turn!  Fuller ball, outside off. Kycia Knight defends it off the back foot.
Tosses it up, on middle. Kycia Knight looks to tuck this away but gets a leading edge towards the bowler who collects it on a bounce.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary for West Indies Women! Loopy ball, full, outside off. Kycia Knight dances down the pitch and smashes it over mid off for a boundary.
Turning back in, around middle. Stafanie Taylor pushes it towards mid-wicket off the back foot for a single.
Wide! Wide of off, spinning in, fuller ball. Stafanie Taylor leaves it alone. Wide called!
Very full, around middle. Stafanie Taylor works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Turning back in, around middle, fuller. Stafanie Taylor defends it out off the back foot.
Outside off, full again, loopy ball. Kycia Knight sweeps it from outside off towards deep square leg for a single.
On the pads now, full this time. Kycia Knight leans and defends it out.
Shorter now, spinning away, outside off. Kycia Knight guides it towards third man for a single.
Pitches it up, on middle. Kycia Knight plays it back to the bowler.
Very full now, around middle. Kycia Knight works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, slower through the air, on middle. Kycia Knight defends it out.
Kycia Knight walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Another one bites the dust! West Indies Women continue to tumble. Omaima Sohail strikes in her first over and Chedean Nation walks back early to the hut. A fuller ball, spinning in, around middle. Chedean Nation looks to flick this away, but she misses as the ball spins in and goes through the gap between bat and pad and knocks the stumps over. West Indies Women lose their fourth wicket!
Slower through the air, around off. Stafanie Taylor steps down and knocks it toward long on for a single.
Shorter again, spinning in, around off. Stafanie Taylor stays back, opens the face of her bat, and guides it towards third man for for two runs.
Omaima Sohail begins with a shorter ball, outside off. Stafanie Taylor slashes it towards deep point for a brace.
Floated, shorter in length and around off. Nation rocks back and punches it to mid off.
Full and outside off. Chedean Nation pushes it back to the bowler.
Looped up, outside off. Nation drives it to the cover fielder.
Fuller ball, outside off. Chedean Nation drives it towards cover.
Chedean Nation walks out to bat.

OUT! STUMPED! Nida Dar gets her second wicket and West Indies Women are in trouble here! Pakistan Women are all over West Indies Women! A shorter ball, around off. Shemaine Campbelle steps down the track and misses as the ball turns back in and sneaks through the gap between bat and pad. Sidra Nawaz collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. Shemaine Campbelle has to walk back!
Commentary.Howout: st Sidra Nawaz b Nida Dar

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, slower through the air, around middle. Stafanie Taylor nudges it towards mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end. The fielder there collects the ball and throws it back to the keeper, who whips the bails off. But the replay shows that the batter is well in.
Is that a run out? The keeper has whipped the bails off and Shemaine Campbelle might be in trouble. The decision has been sent upstairs and the replays show that Campbelle was well inside her crease.
Fuller ball, tosses it up, around middle. Stafanie Taylor steps down and knocks it towards long off for a single.
Flatter and going on with the angle. Stafanie Taylor misses her nudge on the leg side and gets hit on her thigh pad.
Full and on middle. Shemaine Campbelle drives it to long on for a single.
FOUR! A boundary after 35 balls! A low full toss, around off. Shemaine Campbelle steps down and drives it past cover for a boundary.
Fuller ball, outside off. Stafanie Taylor pushes it towards cover for a single.

DROPPED! Oh, dear! Nashra Sandhu drops a catch off her own bowling. A fuller ball, outside off. Stafanie Taylor stays back and hits it to the right of the bowler. Nashra Sandhu moves towards her right, goes for the catch but can't get hold of it. She collides with the non-striker as well.
On a length, outside off. Taylor taps it wide of the point fielder and the batters take a single.
Another ball, flatter and outside off. Stafanie Taylor guides it to backward point.
Flatter ball, spinning in from middle. Shemaine Campbelle stays back and nudges it around the corner and rotates the strike.
Floated, full and on middle. Stafanie Taylor drives it to long on for one run.
On a length, around middle. Shemaine Campbelle tucks it to the leg side and takes a run.
Shemaine Campbelle walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Nida Dar comes into the attack and strikes straightaway! This is a huge moment in this game as the hard-hitter, Dottin makes her way back to the pavilion. Dar serves a flatter ball, slightly shorter in length, outside off. Dottin stays back and ends up hitting it straight to Nida Dar who takes a simple catch moving to her left.
Nida Dar comes to bowl now.
On a length, on middle. Deandra Dottin eases it down to long on for a single.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Stafanie Taylor punches it to through covers and collects a run.
In the air....but safe! Tossed up, outside off. Deandra Dottin kneels and looks to go over long off. She miscues her shot and the ball falls just in front of the long off fielder. A single taken.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Deandra Dottin looks to cut hard but she gets an underedge and onto the deck.
An overpitched ball, on middle. Stafanie Taylor drags it to long on for a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Deandra Dottin cuts it to deep cover and takes a single.
Nashra Sandhu comes into the attack.
Quicker through the air, on a length, just outside off. Taylor pushes it to the off side. 3 runs off the over!
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Taylor gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Aerial but safe! This is tossed up, on off. Stafanie Taylor skips down the track and mistimes her slog just over mid on for a brace.
Floated, full and on off. Stafanie Taylor lunges forward and keeps it out.
On a length, on middle. Deandra Dottin eases it to long on and rotates the strike.
Looped up, around off. Deandra Dottin blocks it out.
BEATEN! This is a good-length delivery, around the corridor of uncertainty. Taylor prods to defend but the ball zips past her outside edge.
A slower ball, full and outside off. Deandra Dottin just runs it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Dottin stays back and tucks it to mid-wicket.
A loopy full ball, outside off. Deandra Dottin gets forward and pushes it towards extra cover.
Fuller in length, outside off. Deandra Dottin drags it to mid on.

An appeal for LBW but turned down! A length ball, angling in from off. Stafanie Taylor hangs back to flick but she misses and gets hit high on her pad. The batters cross for a leg bye as the ball rolls away.
This is tossed up, around off. Deandra Dottin prods and pushes it to the left of the bowler. Another top over from Amin, just a single off it!
On a length, just outside off. Stafanie Taylor punches it through the cover region and takes a single.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Stafanie Taylor cuts it to the cover fielder.
Around off, blocked out.
DROPPED! A tough one for the keeper. This is flatter, angling down leg. Taylor looks to sweep but she gets some glove on it and the ball goes through to the keeper. The keeper puts it down though.
Flatter ball, outside off. Stafanie Taylor taps it towards point.
Good-length delivery, nipping back in, around middle. Deandra Dottin defends it back to the bowler. End of successful over from Fatima Sana!
Change of length now! Much fuller on this occasion, around off. Deandra Dottin pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! Top shot! Short and wide of off. Deandra Dottin hangs back and slashes it powerfully past point for a cracking boundary.
Fatima Sana pitches it up now, around middle. Deandra Dottin drives it towards mid on.
Stafanie Taylor walks out to bat.

OUT! Fatima Sana strikes in her first over! She gets rid of the dangerous Hayley Matthews. Early breakthrough for Pakistan Women! This was a length ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews steps down the pitch and swings her bat and tries to go over long on. But the ball goes off the outer half and flies high towards point. Muneeba Ali runs back towards her left and takes a sharp catch. A crucial wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Muneeba Ali b Fatima Sana

Commentary.Commentary: Fatima Sana begins with a back-of-a-length delivery, around middle. Hayley Matthews looks to pull but she misses and gets hit on her thigh pad.
Fatima Sana comes into the attack.
Outside off, loopy delivery, full. Deandra Dottin leans and blocks it out. A maiden over from Anam Amin! West Indies Women are 19/0 at the end of the Powerplay.
Tad shorter, around middle. Deandra Dottin blocks it out.
Make that four dots! Another loopy ball, around middle, fuller ball. Deandra Dottin gets an inside edge towards square leg.
Fuller ball, around middle. Deandra Dottin plays it towards mid on. Three dots in a row!

So close! Deandra Dottin gets lucky! A loopy ball, full, just outside off. Deandra Dottin gets low and looks to sweep this but she misses as the ball spins away a tad and goes just away from the off pole.
Shorter ball, spinning away, around off. Deandra Dottin blocks it out off the back foot.
Full again, around middle. Deandra Dottin knocks it on the left of mid on and takes a single. She retains the strike. 13 runs off the over!
Much slower this time, full, around middle. Deandra Dottin drives and finds the fielder at mid on.
FOUR! Punished! This is Deandra Dottin at her best! Short, wide of off. Deandra Dottin hangs back and slaps this over point for a boundary. Third boundary of the over!
Swing and a miss! Good-length delivery, shaping away, outside off. Deandra Dottin stays in her crease and looks to pull this but she fails to get any bat on it.

FOUR! Edgy runs! On a length this time, around off. Deandra Dottin looks to heave this on the leg side, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for another boundary. Back-to-back boundaries for Deandra Dottin!
FOUR! Crunched! Pitched up delivery, shaping away, around off. Deandra Dottin waits for it and smashes it over mid off for a boundary.
Tosses it up, slower through the air, full, around off. Deandra Dottin drives it uppishly just away from the bowler. Another single. Two off the over!
Fuller now, around middle. Hayley Matthews drives it towards the right of the bowler. Single taken!
Shorter, outside off. Hayley Matthews chops this one but finds the fielder at cover.
This one comes in with the angle, around middle. Hayley Matthews taps it towards mid-wicket off the back foot.
Loopy ball, much straighter now, outside off. Hayley Matthews looks to cut this away, but she misses once again.
Turn straightaway! Fuller ball, tosses it up, turning away. Hayley Matthews leans to block this but she misses as the ball spins away.
Anam Amin to bowl from the other end.
A stifled appeal for LBW, but turned down! Full, angling in, around the pads. Deandra Dottin gets an inside edge onto her pads.
Full again, on middle. Deandra Dottin pushes it back to the bowler once again.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! First boundary! Pitches it up again, on the pads. Deandra Dottin flicks it towards deep square leg. The fielder from fine leg runs and tries to stop the ball, but she fails to do so and the ball goes on to touch the boundary ropes. West Indies Women and Deandra Dottin are up and running!
Fuller ball, around middle. Deandra Dottin pushes it back to the bowler.

Mix-up...but no harm done! A fuller ball, shaping away, around middle. Deandra Dottin taps it towards mid-wicket. She wanted a run initially but she decides against it in the end. Hayley Matthews was sent back mid-way. The fielder throws it back to the bowler, but Hayley Matthews dives in to make her ground.
Diana Baig begins with a fuller ball, shaping away, outside off. Deandra Dottin drives it towards cover.

Finally, we are set for the 20-over game to begin! The players have made their way out to the middle. Hayley Matthews and Deandra Dottin are at the crease. Diana Baig will start proceedings with the ball for Pakistan Women. Here we go...
It is time for the national anthems! The match officials and players from both sides have lined up for their respective anthems. It will be Pakistan's first, followed by the anthem of West Indies.

PITCH REPORT - Anjum Chopra is near the pitch. She says that the pitch hasn't been affected by the rain. Tells that there is some grass on the pitch and it will help the spinners as the game progresses.
Stafanie Taylor the skipper of West Indies Women, says they would have bowled first as well since the pitch has been covered for a while now. Informs that they have three changes.
Bismah Maroof, the skipper of Pakistan Women, says that they will bowl first. Tells that they will look to restrict West Indies in the first innings and then chase it down later.

West Indies Women (Playing XI) - Deandra Dottin, Hayley Matthews, Stafanie Taylor (C), Shemaine Campbelle (WK), Chedean Nation, Kycia Knight (In for Rashada Williams), Chinelle Henry, Afy Fletcher, Aaliyah Alleyne, Anisa Mohammed (In for Karishma Ramharack), Shakera Selman (In for Shamilia Connell).

Pakistan Women (Playing XI) - Bismah Maroof (C), Sidra Ameen, Muneeba Ali (In for Nahida Khan), Omaima Sohail, Nida Dar, Aliya Riaz, Fatima Sana, Sidra Nawaz (WK), Diana Baig, Nashra Sandhu, Anam Amin (In for Ghulam Fatima).
TOSS - Pakistan Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

UPDATE - 11.20 am IST (5.50 am GMT) - We have good news, folks! Yes, you read that right! Kudos to the groundstaff at Seddon Park. It is going to be a 20-over contest between West Indies Women and Pakistan Women. The play is expected to start at 11.38 am IST (6.08 am GMT).

UPDATE - 10.35 am IST (5.05 am GMT) - The groundstaff is working hard on the wet patches on the outfield and the players of West Indies were also seen warming up. It is bright and sunny at the moment, so we may get to see live action soon. The umpires will have another inspection at 10.45 am IST (5.15 am GMT).

UPDATE - 9.30 am IST (4 am GMT) - The sun is shining bright but there are still some wet patches in the outfield. The groundstaff have asked the match officials for some more time to clear those areas of the ground. There will be another inspection in a short while. Stay tuned for further updates!

In other news, it was Kagiso Rabada's brilliance with the ball that helped South Africa level the ODI series 1-1 against Bangladesh and the decider will be played on Wednesday, 23rd March at Centurion. Bangladesh had no answers with the bat in the 2nd ODI and they will be itching to make amends, come the 23rd of March.

UPDATE - 8.40 am IST (3.10 am GMT) - We have some clear blue skies and the groundsmen are working hard to dry the outfield. The super-sopper is being used and we hope to see some live action soon. The cut-off time for a 20-over game is 11.38 am IST (6.08 am GMT).

UPDATE - 8.05 am IST (2.35 am GMT) - We have some good news, folks! The rain has stopped and the sky looks clear for now. The covers are being taken off and the groundstaff now have a tough task in front of them. Hopefully, we get some play soon. Stay tuned!

UPDATE - 7.35 am IST (2.05 am GMT) - The groundsmen have worked hard and they have got rid of the water on the outfield. However, it still continues to drizzle and we will have to wait a bit longer. We'll surely won't have a 50-over contest.

The third Test of the Benaud-Qadir Trophy begins today at Lahore and it promises to be a cracker as both Australia and Pakistan will be battling hard to clinch the series 1-0. Also, all three ODIs and the one-off T20I between these two sides will now be played at Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore.

UPDATE - 6.35 am IST (1.05 am GMT) - The rain at Hamilton has just eased a little bit. There are still a lot of puddles on the ground but the groundstaff are doing their job and ensuring that they clear the outfield as soon as possible. We hope that the rain stops sooner rather than later and we get to witness yet another thriller in this edition of the Women's World Cup. However, the forecast doesn't look good for the rest of the day either.

We witnessed another draw in the Richards-Botham Trophy and it was the West Indies skipper, Kraigg Brathwaite who led from the front in both the innings, by breaking the record of most balls faced by a West Indian in a Test match and denied England a victory. The third and final Test will now be the decider which begins on Thursday, 24th March.

UPDATE - 6 am IST (12.30 am GMT) - Things are not looking good at Hamilton, folks! The play has been delayed due to rain! It is absolutely bucketing down at the moment and we are in for a long delay as the entire field is under water. Rain was predicted throughout the day and it is raining heavily since morning at Hamilton. As far as semi-final qualification is concerned, both teams would be eager to get out on the park and grab those crucial points. Stay tuned as we bring you further updates.

West Indies Women snatched a victory from the jaws of defeat in their previous game against Bangladesh Women and they will be confident going into this clash against Pakistan. They will be eager to hand a defeat to Pakistan and stay in contention for the semi-finals. Pakistan Women will need a miracle to make it to the sem-final. Will they be able to get a win under their belt? Stay tuned as we shall find that soon. Toss and team news coming up shortly.

Hello and a very warm welcome to game number 20 of the Women's World Cup, 2022. It is West Indies Women taking on Pakistan Women at Seddon Park in Hamilton. Pakistan are yet to open their account in this competition, having played four games, while West Indies have managed to win three out of their five games. We are in for an exciting game as Pakistan will be pushing hard in order to register their first win of the tournament.
... Match Day ...
